name: Ayame Kushinada
source:
The daughter of the chieftain of Yamato Island. Being descended from the protagonist of Destiny Ninja, she inherited the ability to wield the Three Sacred Treasures.

She goes on a journey around Yamato Island to purify the symbols of the four seasons, which are cursed, using the Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven.

[spoiler]Unbeknownst to her, she is cursed so that if she isn't killed by the one she loves before her twentieth birthday, Yamato Island will be destroyed.[/spoiler]
